results.title: AFWL: Excitement grows over 2026 fashion extravaganza
results.description: Adrenaline is pumping in key members of the Africa Fashion Week London 2026 Planning Committee and the privileged designers invited to feature in the globally recognised fashion extravaganza that showcases Africa’s best in couture creativity gains firm up their preparations for the annual event.
